research_rationale:
EO 11468 (signed 1969-05-10; 34 FR 7641) was read in full in the held Federal Register text layer. Acting under section 5317 of title 5, U.S. Code, it amends Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965, as amended: section 1 deletes level IV item (9), Executive Director, Cabinet Committee on Price Stability, and inserts item (9), Deputy Under Secretary for International Labor Affairs, Department of Labor; section 2 adds level V items (23), Deputy Assistant Postmaster General, Bureau of Operations, Post Office Department, and (24), Director, Office of Minority Business Enterprise, Department of Commerce. The clauses below are the three placements the order made (one per item, lead and introductions folded in); the deletion of the earlier item (9) was performed when the order took effect. Item (24) was amended by EO 11516 (1970-03-19), which deleted it and inserted in the same item number “Assistant to the Secretary, Department of Commerce”; under the strike-and-insert ruling (2026-10-21) that is an amendment recorded as a later event, the clause continuing, amended (substance changed: note for the human reviewer). Item (23) was deleted outright, with no replacement, by EO 11634 (signed 1971-12-06), which first ended that clause on that date. The Postal Reorganization Act's abolition of the Post Office Department is not held and is not relied on as an end. EO 11581, EO 11540, EO 11604 and EO 11634 also renumbered items. EO 11708 (signed 1973-03-23) section 3 revoked EO 11248 as amended except the eight level V positions in its section 2, which include neither the Commerce assistant nor the Labor deputy under secretary, so clauses 1 and 3 first ended on 1973-03-23; the whole-order end is the latest first end, 1973-03-23. Original not an authenticated transcription: the held text is the OCR text layer of the official Federal Register issue; quotations avoid its recognition errors.
